summary: Verify offline isolated prebuilt Rust adoption

delivery.outcome: Prove offline isolated PEP517 adoption of installed prebuilt Rust on actual NL code; independent protected merge and preserved checkout cleanup.
nonGoals: Consumer source migration, universal hermeticity/security or performance claim.

architecture.decision: Add optional --build-wheelhouse to developer NL pilot, requiring --prebuilt-rust. Snapshot only regular flat local wheels and hash inventory; require exact current SDK wheel bytes. Prepare fresh pip-only frontend, install build only from snapshot offline and verify Sorust/Cython/setuptools are absent there. Let real isolated PEP517 install declared build requirements from snapshot with Cargo/rustc failure stubs. Record frontend/isolation/input receipts; preserve existing default prepared-environment behavior. Validate guards, missing local dependency rejection and actual pinned source/wheel/export conformance. Practical5fe81a1discovery: seeded pip user_agent probes rustc --version despite local-only installation. For isolated mode use a private PATH of required C compiler/binutils aliases and verify cargo/rustc absent; keep prior failure-stub policy for prepared mode. This avoids optional frontend Rust probing and strengthens toolchain-unavailable proof without changing backend or weakening no-Rust requirement.
dataChanges: Add optional informational isolation/wheelhouse/frontend fields to private pilot result; no runtime manifest change.
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert of developer tooling; default pilot and native artifacts remain supported.

validation.evidence: Reject unsafe/stale wheelhouse inputs before installation, preserve snapshots and prior output, real missing local build dependency refuses ambient fallback.
Actual pinned NL fresh frontend isolated sdist->wheel/no Rust invocations,24original conformance across3modes, missing Cython rejection, canonicalv20, final artifact/input identity checks.
